title: Money That Lasts
subtitle: Saving, spending and paying less tax
summary: For someone planning to stop work early. It starts with the 4 percent rule, where it came from and why the order of good and bad years matters once you are spending, all tested against US market history since 1871. Most of the rest is tax: how a return stacks, the four kinds of account, the low-income years when a Roth conversion costs little, health cover before Medicare. Branches cover Washington State, moving to Portugal, and pay in company stock. It explains how the rules work; it is not personal advice.

release.note: Every lesson revised after a student read-through: terms defined where they first appear, worked numbers checked against the 2026 rules, and clearer cross-references between lessons.
